resolutions.researcher_notes: No independent source describes this specific West Qurna->Rumaila gas pipeline as 'under construction'. Extensive EN+AR searching only surfaces the broader BGC/GGIP gas-gathering scheme (capturing associated gas from Rumaila, Zubair, West Qurna) and unrelated lines (13.7 km North Rumaila feed-gas, 80 km broadcut export, 10.2 km dry-gas grid link; a separate 40 km/42-in Khor Al-Zubair->Shatt Al-Arab dry-gas line, Iraq Business News 2025-03-16). The seed citation (ahewar.org compilation, re-read via Wayback) mentions the fields but names no such pipeline or its status. Construction status uncorroborated.

Fuel=Gas is corroborated by the broader context: BGC and TotalEnergies (GGIP) both document that the West Qurna / Rumaila development is an associated-gas gathering-and-processing scheme (gas, not oil). Two independent sources, but they corroborate the gas context of the fields, not this specific named pipeline (which no source names). Tier medium for that reason.
No independent source names this pipeline, so its classification as 'transmission' cannot be corroborated. Uncorroborated.

StartYear1=2025 not corroborated by any independent source for this specific pipeline. GGIP-related gas commissioning runs 2025-2028, but no source ties a 2025 start to a West Qurna->Rumaila line. Uncorroborated.

LengthKnown=50 km not found in any independent source. Documented southern-Iraq gas lines have different lengths (13.7 km, 80 km, 10.2 km, 40 km). '50 km' appears in sources only as the distance of the Rumaila-West Qurna field west of Basra, not as a pipeline length. Uncorroborated.

Diameter=40 in not found in any independent source for this pipeline. The nearest documented figure is a separate Khor Al-Zubair->Shatt Al-Arab line at 42 in / 40 km (Iraq Business News, 2025-03-16) - different endpoints and specs, not a match. Uncorroborated.

FuelSource=Qurna corroborated: BGC explicitly lists West Qurna 1 among the fields whose associated gas it gathers/processes, and TotalEnergies GGIP includes West Qurna as a gas source. Two independent sources confirm West Qurna as a gas source in this area; they do not name this specific pipeline, hence tier medium.

Endpoints corroborated as real gas fields in southern Iraq (Basra): GeoExpro ('Rumaila-West Qurna, Iraq') and BGC both place West Qurna and Rumaila in southern Iraq. This supports StartCountryOrArea=Iraq, EndLocation=Rumela (Rumaila), EndCountryOrArea=Iraq. Two independent sources agree, so tier high for the location values. Note: neither source describes a direct pipeline between the two fields.
